transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Thursday, August 13. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Who next? Tata Steel MD's name does the rounds after Chandrasekaran steps down. 'Not prepared', P 26 10 Test defeats and two clean sweeps: But Amit Mishra says 'give Gambhir time'. The worst for India under Gambhir's coaching has come in the Tests. In the six Test series that India have played since Gambhir took charge as head coach (one-off Test against Afghanistan not included), they have won just two - against Bangladesh and West Indies at home. Months after Dells' $6.25Bn 'gift', US Treasury sets new Trump Account paycheck rules. New rules from the US Treasury and IRS will allow payroll contributions to Trump Accounts. Employers can contribute up to $2,500 tax-free annually for employees' dependent children. Employees will also have the option to make pre-tax paycheck contributions directly into these accounts. Michael and Susan Dell pledged $6.25 billion to fund this child savings initiative. 'Deliberate cover up': SC orders CBI probe into Chhattisgarh custodial death. Says Admin, Police Attempted To Pull The Wool Over Court's Eyes US sailors trying to jump overboard amid extended Middle East deployment: Report. Sailors aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln have reportedly attempted to jump overboard amid mounting mental health concerns and an extended Middle East deployment, with military families and US lawmakers warning that conditions aboard the aircraft carrier are reaching a breaking point. Ex-Microsoft CEO Steve Ballmer changes how his $8 billion philanthropy works. Steve and Connie Ballmer are redefining their charitable strategy. The Ballmer Group is set to detach three regional branches, allowing them to operate as independent nonprofits. This adaptation is designed to align funding strategies more closely with the needs of local communities. With over eight billion dollars donated to charity, the Ballmers will shift their emphasis toward national-level initiatives focusing on economic mobility. 'Guilty will not be spared': Heads likely to roll for AI Phuket flight incident. NEW DELHI: Government has warned Air India to improve its oversight on operations and "take responsibility" for ensuring safety. US removed 100 outdated dams, setting a new river restoration record. In 2025, the US removed 100 outdated and unsafe dams across 30 states, reconnecting more than 4,893 miles of rivers, the highest number of upstream river miles restored through dam removal in a single year. The projects reopened fish habitats, improved river connectivity and addressed public safety concerns. Pennsylvania led with 14 removals, followed by Massachusetts with 11 and Vermont with nine. 'Evasive, misleading': Parliamentary panel on Justice Varma's testimony. NEW DELHI: The Lok Sabha Speaker appointed inquiry committee in its report has recommended further action while indicting Justice Yashwant Varma for recovery of wads of 500-rupee notes at his official residence in Delhi in March last year, its unexplained disappearance and an evasive judge failing to explain "presence, source or ownership" of the huge money. Mexico clears 100,000 tons of sargassum as seaweed crisis hits tourism. In 2026, a massive expanse of Sargassum seaweed has taken over the Atlantic Ocean, wreaking havoc on coastal areas. Mexico is facing an unprecedented surge in seaweed accumulation, which is damaging its tourism sector. The foul odor has led to a notable decline in visitors, leaving local businesses in distress. Though scientists predict improvement by late autumn, a permanent solution is still unknown. Oracle layoffs: Company's '6 am layoff emails' may return in next few days. Oracle is preparing another round of layoffs this month, with cuts reaching double-digit percentages on some teams and managers already asked to name affected employees. The company wants payroll reduced before its second quarter starts on September 1. Oracle has already shed 21,000 jobs in a year, down to 141,000 staff, as it funds a debt-heavy AI data centre buildout that burned $23.7 billion in cash last fiscal year. 'Absurd timelines': SC says only 12-15 cases for each UAPA court. NEW DELHI: A week after criticising long delay in trial of a Popular Front of India (PFI) activist facing UAPA charges by asserting that "lifespan of a criminal trial cannot be that of a turtle", Supreme Court on Wednesday again slammed the Karnataka govt for submitting a prosecution plan "as absurd as a fairytale".

Dixon Technologies (India) is currently under the process of incorporating a subsidiary company with the name and style 'Adivistar Electronics India' wherein Dixon would be acquiring 51 percent equity shares comprising of 25,50,000 equity shares of rupees 10/- each. INR stays pressured by elevated oil prices amid uncertainty surrounding Hormuz re-opening. The rupee settled just 3 paise higher at 95.33 (provisional) against the US dollar on Wednesday, as hopes of a quick US-Iran agreement and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz faded. Brent crude is moving towards USD 90 per barrel amid risk aversion in global markets. At the interbank foreign exchange, the rupee opened at 95.40 against the greenback and traded in a range of 95.24-95.43 during the session. It eventually settled at 95.33 (provisional), higher by 3 paise from its previous close. Cisco stock rises ahead of Q4 earnings as investors focus on AI networking demand. Bank of America will acquire up to 49.9 percent of Jio Financial Services' Jio Credit Limited for up to rupees 18,268 crore. The investment includes a 26.5 percent initial equity stake, subject to regulatory approvals, and aims to enhance BofA's participation in India's growing market. Microdrama is now a mainstream Indian entertainment format, with most audiences preferring it. IRCTC Q1 Results: Revenue rises 18 percent , profit remains largely flat at rupees 330 crore. IRCTC reported a net profit of 330.16 crore for the June quarter, slightly down from 330.71 crore a year ago. Revenue rose 18.1 percent to 1,369.53 crore YoY but fell 6.2 percent sequentially. Tourism revenue declined sharply, while catering showed strong growth. Bank credit growth spikes to 19 percent on year. transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Karnataka Bandh on August 13, 2026: Are banks open or closed on Thursday? Check bank holiday status. Bank customers in Karanata may be wondering whether the statewide bandh will affect their offline banking services. Pro-Kannada organisations have called for a Karnataka bandh over the Cauvery water dispute, while also demanding progress on some projects in Karnataka. Karnataka bandh today: Are banks open or closed in Bengaluru on Thursday, August 13?. Essential services are expected to remain operational during the statewide bandh in Karnataka on Thursday. NPS choices for NRIs explained: Can NRIs invest in Tier II NPS accounts? Check rules and investment options. For Non-Resident Indians, establishing a retirement corpus back home is simplified with the National Pension System. NRIs can open a Tier-I account, the essential foundation for retirement savings. Contributions are permitted from NRE and NRO accounts, facilitating smooth repatriation. Subscribers enjoy a range of investment choices, spanning equity, corporate bonds, and government securities, and can opt for either active or automated investment management in line with their risk appetite. Four equity fund categories saw outflows in July despite gains: Should investors be concerned?. Four equity fund categories , large-cap, dividend-yield, value, and ELSS , saw net outflows in July despite mostly positive returns. Experts explain the key reasons behind the trend and what investors should consider before making changes to their portfolios. When will government issue plastic currency notes? Minister reveals this in Parliament. The circulation of plastic currency notes is set to begin in the next financial year, as confirmed by the Reserve Bank of India's governor following a recent policy meeting. The government has greenlit the RBI's proposal for field trials, with the procurement of these polymer banknotes currently underway. However, specific details regarding the launch date and associated costs remain undisclosed. Zerodha Fund House unveils arbitrage fund for short-term cash management, investment starts at rupees 5,000. The new fund offer is aimed at investors looking to park surplus money for relatively short periods while keeping volatility lower than that typically associated with pure equity funds. Life certificate submission for NRI pensioners: BPS seeks email facility for overseas central government pensioners. Overseas pensioners encounter challenges when submitting digital life certificates due to issues with authentication and internet connectivity. Bharat Pensioners Samaj suggests that the government accept verified life certificates through registered email IDs, aiming to make the process easier for elderly pensioners living abroad. They point out that a similar digital solution works for Defence pensioners, urging the implementation of this additional option ahead of the upcoming submission deadline. Child certificate under Income Tax Act 2025: What is it, who needs it and how to generate one?. Form 128 allows taxpayers to obtain lower or nil TDS/TCS certificates. Under the Income Tax 2025, child certificates can be generated for individual payers. Here's what they mean, who needs them, and how to get them. Will 8th Pay Commission submit its report before 18-month deadline? Minister clarifies. 8th Pay Commission news: The 8th Pay Commission is currently engaging with various stakeholders regarding issues related to pay and pensions. The findings are expected to be submitted within 18 months of its formation. Led by chairperson Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai, this initiative aims to benefit nearly 35.77 lakh civilian employees and 33.76 lakh pensioners. Modifications to guidelines for consultant involvement have been introduced by the commission. Bought co-owner's 50 percent share in a property? How capital gains tax applies when selling whole asset. Buying a co-owner's share in a jointly owned property can make capital gains tax calculations more complex when you sell the whole asset. The two shares may have different acquisition dates and costs, affecting how the gains are taxed. 22k gold rate today: Check 18k, 20k, 22k, 24k gold prices (August 12, 2026) at Tanishq, Malabar Gold and Diamonds, Joyalukkas, Kalyan Jewellers and IBJA. Gold rates today: If you are planning to buy gold jewellery, here is a look at the latest 22K gold rates at Tanishq, Malabar Gold and Diamonds, Joyalukkas and Kalyan Jewellers across major cities. Small-cap funds attract highest ever monthly inflow in July: Is your equity portfolio taking the right risk?. Small-cap mutual funds attracted a record rupees 7,768 crore in July, while large-cap funds saw their first outflow in 30 months. The sharp shift in equity fund flows raises questions about small-cap exposure, portfolio diversification and the right level of equity risk for investors. Nifty 50 needs 8 percent returns to reclaim peak; mid-caps narrow gap: What it means for investors. Large-, mid- and small-cap indices are at different stages of recovery from their previous peaks. While Nifty Midcap 150 is almost back to its record high, Nifty 50 has a wider gap to close. A study highlights how past corrections have shaped recovery timelines. FD rates: Which banks are offering the best returns on fixed deposits right now?. DCB Bank, RBL Bank, YES Bank, Tamilnad Mercantile Bank and Jammu and Kashmir Bank are among the banks offering some of the highest FD interest rates across various tenures for deposits of up to rupees 1 crore. Wife sought higher maintenance citing husband's wealth; High Court rejects plea but orders rupees 46 lakh for daughters' education. Husband claims rupees 20 lakh debt and lost his earning capacity due to the hostile atmosphere and false complaints by wife; HC rejects wife's higher maintenance claim but orders him to pay rupees 46 lakh for daughters education. Know why he lost the case in Madhya Pradesh High Court. Returning to India? How RNOR status can help NRIs save tax on foreign income. During the RNOR phase, local income rules mirror those applicable to ordinary residents. Any revenue sourced within India, such as domestic salary, rental proceeds from local property, or fixed deposit interest, remains fully taxable and must be reported in the ITR Canara Bank, Bank of Baroda increase lending rates: Why loan EMIs for these borrowers may rise after hikes. Bank of Baroda and Canara Bank have raised their lending rates. These banks increased their Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rates by up to ten basis points. The revised rates for both banks become effective from August 12, 2026. Borrowers with loans linked to MCLR may see their interest payments rise. NPS for platform workers: How Zomato and Swiggy delivery partners can build a retirement corpus with rupees 99 contribution. PFRDA has highlighted the NPS scheme for platform workers, with contributions starting at just rupees 99 to help build a retirement corpus. The scheme allows flexible contributions and portability, but there's more to know about how workers can enrol, contribute and withdraw. From welfare facilities to working conditions: What manufacturing employees are entitled to under new labour code rules. Employees working in manufacturing sector can clarity on what benefits they are entitled to and what their employer must provide, under new labour code rules. Read the article to know more. Sold property but missed expense deductions in original ITR? Here's what Mumbai ITAT ruling says. A Mumbai ITAT ruling has offered relief to a taxpayer who claimed rupees 37.16 lakh in property-related expenses during reassessment. The tribunal examined whether such claims could be allowed later and ultimately directed the tax department to delete the additions. Presumptive taxation for professionals: The 50 percent rule remains-but what changes for deductions and losses under the new tax Act?. The 50 percent presumptive taxation rule for professionals largely continues under the new Income-tax Act. However, Section 58(4) introduces a wider restriction on deductions and losses against presumptive income. Here is what professionals need to know before filing their returns.
